name: FairRyde never sanctions accounts
statement: FairRyde never suspends, holds or deactivates an account; it may only recommend a human review.

sources.quote: modify, suspend or terminate operation of or access to the Platform, or any portion of the Platform (including access to your account and/or the availability of any products or services), for any reason
Organisations should define significant checkpoints or action boundaries that require human approval, especially before sensitive actions are executed.
